t: A one line instruction for envy
a: إِذَا نَظَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْخَلْقِ، فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ
p: Idhā naẓara aḥadukum ilā man fuḍḍila ʿalayhi fi-l-māli wa-l-khalq, fa-l-yanẓur ilā man huwa asfalu minh
m: When one of you looks at someone given more than him in wealth and in appearance, let him look at the one who is below him.
